description_en: Queries the number of dropped packets within a period of time
description_zh: 查看专享实例一定时间内丢弃数据包数
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi describe-instance-drop-packet --start-time 2022-09-06T04:00:36Z --end-time 2022-12-16T02:04:36Z --instance-id apigateway-cn-v641b9dxc00p --sbc-name Maximum --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceDropPacket

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The statistical metric. Valid values:

Maximum

Minimum

Average
parameters.help_zh:
统计指标
Maximum 最大
Minimum 最小
Average 平均
parameters.name: sbc_name

MonitorItem.description_en: The list of dropped packets in the instance

Item.description_en:
The metric. Valid values:

InstanceDropPacketRX: the number of inbound packets dropped in the instance per second.

InstanceDropPacketTX: the number of outbound packets dropped in the instance per second
Item.description_zh:
指标
InstanceDropPacketRX 实例每秒丢弃入包数
InstanceDropPacketTX 实例每秒丢弃出包数

ItemTime.description_en: The monitoring time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
ItemTime.description_zh: 时间坐标，按照ISO8601标准表示。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

ItemValue.description_en: The number of dropped packets in the instance
